steps.speaker: Yanyan
steps.content: In the great hall, the divine lay; all spells ordered, elements reigned.
Yanyan closes the book in her hands and gazes reverently toward the Statue of Keylan not far away, her previous vivacity gone. The usually fearless, curious girl even swallows hard nervously.

steps.speaker: Yanyan
steps.content: Only by passing the Divine Lord's trial can one obtain the arrow capable of shooting down the Sun Crow.

steps.speaker: Yanyan
steps.content: But even back in Sunsink City, few seers have actually seen the Divine Lord. We only hear legends about the Divine Lord, so... Yanyan is a bit scared.

steps.speaker: Choice
options: Hey, don't worry. Everyone will be cheering for you, Yanyan.

steps.content: You smile at the two soldiers behind you.

steps.speaker: FAC Soldier A
steps.content: You people from Eastia are all about that superstitious stuff... I mean, as long as it works.

steps.speaker: FAC Soldier B
steps.content: Yeah, just go and be confident. We'll wait here for you. We'll do what you say.

steps.speaker: FAC Soldier A
steps.content: Well, at least we can still hear birds chirping here. Could have been worse.

steps.speaker: FAC Soldier B
steps.content: I know, right? We've seen way worse in Keylan Square before. You just do your best, kiddo!

steps.speaker: Yanyan
steps.content: Okay! Yanyan won't let you down!
Hearing everyone's encouragement, a smile finally emerges on her tense little face.
